request.description:
Create a new purchase order.

**Required Fields:**
- supplier_id: ID of the supplier
- items[0][product_id]: Product ID for at least one item
- items[0][quantity]: Quantity for the item
- items[0][unit_price]: Unit price for the item

**Optional Fields:**
- order_date: Order date (defaults to today)
- expected_delivery_date: Expected delivery date
- notes: Additional notes
- items[n][product_id]: Additional items
- items[n][quantity]: Quantity for additional items
- items[n][unit_price]: Unit price for additional items

**Note:** You can add multiple items using array notation items[0], items[1], etc.
Get a specific purchase order by its ID with complete details including items, shipments, and payments.

request.description:
Update an existing purchase order.

**Optional Fields:**
- supplier_id: Update supplier
- order_date: Update order date
- expected_delivery_date: Update expected delivery date
- status: pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled
- notes: Update notes

**Note:** Use _method=PUT in form data. Cannot update items through this endpoint - items are managed separately.
